title: 電飾スタンド看板
description: 飲食店の店先に置く、キャスター付きの電飾スタンド看板です。黒いアルミ枠と天板、両面の無地の発光アクリル面、重りの台座とキャスター、電源コードの出口を造形しています。面は文字のない無地で、発光は材質の自発光のみです。電源コード、照明器具、店名やメニューは含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.540 × 1.080 × 0.420 m、1,780三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A castered illuminated light-box sign for restaurant frontages. It models the black aluminium frame and top cap, blank lit acrylic faces on both sides, a weighted base with casters and a power-cord gland. Faces are blank; illumination is only an emissive material. Power cords, light fittings, shop names and menus are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.540 × 1.080 × 0.420 m; 1,780 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
